dedupe_keys.name: dss simpy rl opendss and simpy cyber physical reinforcement learning environment

description: DSS-SimPy-RL is an open-source environment for training reinforcement learning agents on cyber-physical power distribution problems, combining OpenDSS for the grid with the SimPy discrete event package for the communication network. It was released in 2023 by the National Renewable Energy Laboratory with Abhijeet Sahu, Venkatesh Venkataramanan and Richard Macwan as developers, because most cyber emulators run on Unix while power simulators run on Windows, and co-simulation is too slow to generate the large amounts of experience agents need. SimPy makes the cyber side operating-system independent. The repository includes OpenDSS files for the IEEE 123-bus feeder with and without distributed energy resources, deep Q-learning agents including prioritised experience replay, and a volt-var control environment adapted from Siemens PowerGym, and the developers used it to train agents for resilient re-routing, network reconfiguration and volt-var control. Coverage is not tied to a place. The code is accessible on GitHub under the MIT licence at no cost. Caveats: there are no tagged releases, the last commit was in May 2023, and the cyber model is an emulation, not a real network stack. Simulation uses are training resilient control against communication failures and cyber events. Related records: platform-powergridworld and platform-opendss.
